summary: Defines procedures for allocating and retiring special-purpose MPLS labels, which come from a small set of 16, and a way to extend the special-purpose label space. It renames the IANA registry and creates an Extended Special-Purpose MPLS Label Values registry. It updates several earlier RFCs that use the term reserved label.

eli5.summary: There are only 16 special tags and they are nearly used up. This document sets rules for handing out and taking back tags, and makes a way to have more.
